metadata_source: Public primary model cards and Hugging Face file metadata checked with browsing; no model weights downloaded.
first_task_remains: Clarify the privacy-validation policy and A/B/C/D protocol before expanding the benchmark.
notes: Publisher-reported file SHA is metadata, not a locally verified checksum.
All revisions must be resolved to immutable commits and files verified before inference.
Rounded display sizes are decimal MB/GB, not exact byte counts or measured RAM.
Missing reasoning controls or context capacity are N/A with a reason, not zero quality.
Do not add planned models to completed result tables or the product default based on model-card claims.

models.name: LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct
models.why_test: Small-model alternative for extraction and classification.
models.native_reasoning_card_note: Instruct checkpoint; the separately published Thinking checkpoint is a different model.
models.russian_card_note: Russian absent from the listed eight languages; actual RU capability unmeasured.
models.context_card_note: 32768 tokens reported; validate GGUF and runtime.

models.name: LFM2.5-2.6B
models.why_test: Hybrid model between the existing 2B and 4B candidates, with Russian listed.
models.native_reasoning_card_note: Card explicitly says pure reasoning and always thinks; template injects think. Do not label an unsupported switch as thinking off.
models.context_card_note: 131072 tokens reported; validate GGUF and runtime.

models.name: Tiny Aya Global
models.why_test: Multilingual candidate for RU/EN extraction and privacy validation.
models.native_reasoning_card_note: Instruction-tuned global checkpoint; do not substitute base or thinker variants. Supported reasoning controls must be probed.
models.context_card_note: Card lists 8K input and 8K output; do not assume a 16K combined window. Validate artifact/runtime accounting before full-document tests.

models.name: Qwen3.5-4B
models.why_test: Within-family comparison against completed Qwen3.5-0.8B and 2B results.
models.native_reasoning_card_note: Official card provides enable_thinking=False through the serving API; verify the rendered native template and runtime behavior.
models.russian_card_note: Evaluate RU/EN on the same corpus; no quality result inferred from family size.
models.context_card_note: 262144 native context tokens reported; benchmark budgets remain separately fixed.

models.name: Spark-X2.6-4B
models.why_test: Additional 4B family and controllable reasoning comparison.
models.native_reasoning_card_note: Official card advertises none/low/high thinking levels. Probe mapping to our runtime rather than treating them as interchangeable with other families.
models.russian_card_note: Card is tagged English/Chinese; actual RU quality must be measured.
models.context_card_note: Resolve native GGUF/runtime limits before choosing a full-document profile.

artifact.metadata_limit: Filename and rounded size confirmed in official file tree; file-page SHA unavailable through the browsing tool and must be resolved before download.

models.name: LFM2.5-8B-A1B
models.why_test: MoE candidate to test compute/quality tradeoff; total weights and actual memory remain relevant.
models.native_reasoning_card_note: Reasoning-tuned checkpoint; assistant turns contain reasoning. Off/bounded support in our runtime is not yet confirmed.
models.russian_card_note: Russian absent from the feature-language list; actual RU capability unmeasured.
models.context_card_note: 128000 tokens reported in model card; validate GGUF and runtime.
models.architecture_card_note: MoE hybrid convolution/attention; active parameters are not a RAM estimate.
